edges.reason: The target explicitly selects among chart types and reads their data. Its line-chart branch contains value/trend reading as a necessary conceptual component; teaching all charts together still has to provide that content, so this is not merely a requirement for earlier exposure.
edges.scope: Reading line-chart values and change direction when selecting/interpreting the line-chart branch

edges.reason: Choosing a pie chart for proportions and reading its data requires the part-to-whole percentage encoding, which is the necessary component of this endpoint. It does not impose every primary percent-counting exercise on other chart branches.
edges.scope: Understanding the part-to-whole encoding of a pie chart when selecting and reading that branch

edges.reason: The percent criterion explicitly represents the multiplicative relation between two numbers. A hundredths fraction represents that same quotient comparison; avoiding formal ratio terminology does not remove the relation itself. Require only this shared meaning, not prior completion of ratio exercises or notation.
edges.scope: The quotient meaning of the multiplicative comparison between two quantities
